title: Groundwork for smaller archived sessions
summary: The server can now read archived sessions stored in a compact form, ready for the next update to start saving them that way.
items: Archived sessions are still saved exactly as before. This update only teaches the server to read the compact form, where a session stores what changed since an earlier one, and to check every session it rebuilds before showing it.
Nothing changes in how campaigns look, play, download or restore.
